I pitched a market-neutral 120-day momentum rule (long top 8, short bottom 8 of the 40-name universe, monthly rebalance). It passed all the validation gates on the held-out window, so the pod is eligible. It isn't seeded yet: capital shows no pods, so there is no mandate to place orders against today.

Results of the pitch:
- Held-out window (2024-03-20 to 2024-09-16): Sharpe 17.6, annual return 92%, max drawdown -0.5%, mean IC 0.44 over 360 predictions.
- Gates: IC pass, deflated Sharpe pass (1.0 vs 0.95 threshold), capacity pass, correlation with pod 1 pass (0.06).

Caveats:
